meta.title: AI-Pass — Policy checks before AI runs
meta.description: AI-Pass routes requests to frontier models only after they pass your organisation's policy. Every decision is recorded.

hero.headline: Policy checks before any AI model runs.
hero.subheadline: AI-Pass routes requests to frontier models only after they pass your organisation's policy, including EU data residency and approval rules. Every decision is recorded.

secondaryCta.label: See how a request is checked

problem.headline: Regulated work needs proof at the moment AI runs.

items.title: Rules must apply before the model
items.copy: Regulated organisations need to show, at the moment an AI system runs, that the request met their rules.

items.title: Approvals need a queue
items.copy: Some requests should wait for a named approver. Others must stay in an EU region or never leave the organisation.

items.title: Every decision needs a record
items.copy: Auditors ask what was allowed, what was blocked, and why. Guesswork is not an audit trail.

howItWorks.headline: One request. One policy check. One audit record.

steps.label: Request
steps.copy: An application or agent sends a model request with context.

steps.label: Policy gate
steps.copy: AI-Pass checks organisation rules, residency, and approval requirements.

steps.label: Decision
steps.copy: The gate allows, queues for approval, or blocks the request.

steps.label: Model
steps.copy: Only allowed requests reach a configured frontier or private model.

steps.label: Audit record
steps.copy: The decision and path are written to an immutable audit event.

demo.headline: Coming soon
demo.copy: A client-side simulation will let you choose a sample request and policy type, then show allow, queue or block with an audit entry. Simulation using sample data only.

governance.headline: Built to support regulated obligations
governance.intro: AI-Pass is designed to support obligations under GDPR, the EU AI Act, DORA and NIS2.
governance.soc2: SOC 2 Type II: observation phase. Target completion March 2027.

rows.provides: EU data residency policy type, audit records, access controls
Policy checks and decision records before model execution
Operational controls and audit evidence for ICT risk reviews
Access control and logging aligned with security obligations

deployment.headline: SaaS now. On-premises later.
deployment.onprem: Private cloud, on-premises and air-gapped: in development. Packaging planned for 30 April 2027.

designPartners.headline: Early access with direct roadmap input
designPartners.copy: We are working with a small number of regulated organisations on pilots. Design partners get early access and direct input into the roadmap.
